title: P104: 204-CLEAR candidate κ 0.003665051802188; extra exact-Q erasure applicability unresolved
body:
## Change and mathematical scope
**Additional exact-Q erasure applicability is unresolved.** This is a conditional research candidate, not an equal-premise frontier improvement, unconditional theorem or practical speedup. Conditional signed κ = 0.003665051802188; retained native/signed candidate-adapted calculations pass, but those calculations do not establish the extra reset premise.

204 CLEARs = 74 matched-base + 130 stationary. Six matched-base exact-Q CLEAR forms change (indices 27,37,44,54,62,63), including owner1557 at chart595. All 204 certificates lie in the public-row span, but that does not implement physical erasure or prove coverage under the original supplier contract. Five inherited assumptions remain: native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery. The signed receipt's assumptions array lists only those five; it is NOT certification of the additional exact-Q reset applicability. #7609's unchanged-events argument is not transferred to these changed forms. No common-U implementation or implication is claimed.

## Task, identity and overlap
Changed/refined p104-side-correction scope, detailed TASK.json. Base main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Only one new research directory,34 files; existing PRs and shared code unchanged. Word:77372 events, compressed SHA256 bfe2a4fb54dd82940ba78d8b3efd4f587e3fc9e978ccfd48561199d2c9fb4887, canonical c14f365d254598f6a2daa349b47f815d20c649f0439cc36897b531412e19a3de.

Direct construction chain extends #7616 (22b310ba50a554b6111804824782793beb41073f), with source #7605 (e1d2756eecf03e146338239fee81772a99ba8d4c), not a claim of all-new independent work. #7620 is an earlier167-CLEAR checkpoint. #7622 shares the902@595 drop and owner1557 form, but its902/1091 contact rechart is absent here; its unimplemented common-U premise is explicitly distinguished. #7623's14 drop locations/partners overlap:10 exact local ADD sequences and4 further-contracted variants in this candidate, as recorded in evidence. #7621's1445/1461 courier and226 re-stop are absent. No exclusive novelty/priority claim for overlapping edits or courier mechanisms.

No hosted CI, human acceptance or proof-kernel acceptance claimed.

## Reproduction and publication-only safeguards
Python3.12, assertions enabled; separately obtain authenticated #7605 source closure:

    python reproduce.py --source /path/to/pr7605/research/p104-timed-helper757 --work /short/new-work --stage all
    python scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-w2-primal-dual-bypass

Open-PR data are vendored and pinned; full replay still requires #7605 source. Exact adapter substitutions and before/after audit included; original source stays unchanged. Publication copy adds guards rejecting -O/-OO and --skip-pins and requiring PINS.json. Tested -O rejection, skip-pins rejection and normal --help success. Scientific runners/word were not changed. Local home prefixes in diagnostic paths/diff headers are redacted; PINS regenerated. No clean-run claim inferred from these lightweight tests.

## Open next questions
First assess whether the six changed exact-Q forms and130 added stationary lifetimes admit reset at the stated finite tariff under a common supplier model. Separately reproduce the complete application in a clean environment. The pre-cleanup204-CLEAR checkpoint preserves old base forms and has diagnostic κ .003664744076078, but has not separately passed full Step-3 and is not offered as a verified fallback theorem.
